newsitem.title: HONG KONG: MAS unit 10 bln yen FRN group forms.
newsitem.headline: MAS unit 10 bln yen FRN group forms.

text.p: A group has formed for Malaysia Airlines Capital (L) Ltd's five-year 10 billion yen floating rate notes issue, the lead managers said on Tuesday.
The issue is guaranteed by Malaysian Airline System Berhad.
The notes were issued at par to float at 25 basis points over the six-month yen London Interbank Offered Rate. There is a combined management and underwriting fee of 15 basis points.
The notes have received a preliminary A-plus rating from Nippon Investors Service Inc.
Daiwa Securities (HK) and Sanwa International Finance are lead managers.
Chase Manhattan Asia is co-lead manager.
Banque et Caisse D'Epargne de L'Etat Luxembourg, Landesbank Rheinland-Pfalz Girozentrale, Mitsui Trust International and Die ERSTE Osterreichische Spar-Casse-Bank are managers.
Signing is tentatively set for May 23. The payment date is tentatively set for May 28.
